players.product: LIDE laser-induced deep etching for glass-core substrates and through-glass vias (TGV)

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 release (figures beyond the call): H1 revenue fell 38.3% from EUR 59.2 million; Q2 revenue was EUR 19.3 million versus EUR 33.8 million a year earlier; H1 new orders EUR 44.0 million versus EUR 43.0 million; EBIT EUR -14.1 million in H1 (prior year EUR -1.7 million) and EUR -7.2 million in Q2 (prior year EUR +2.2 million); Q2 adjusted EBIT EUR -4.8 million (prior year EUR +2.8 million). Segments: Development order intake increased significantly with revenue slightly below prior year; Electronics H1 revenue and order intake significantly above prior year despite a weak Q2, with geopolitical tensions delaying individual shipments; Solar revenue and order intake well below prior year; Welding revenue significantly below prior year.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 2026 revenue EUR 19.3 million (prior year EUR 33.8 million); H1 new orders EUR 44.0 million; H1 EBIT EUR -14.1 million
quarterly_data.quarter: LPKF Laser & Electronics press release: LPKF Presents Half-Year Financial Report (07-23-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 forecast confirmed (company release): consolidated revenue of EUR 105 to 120 million and an adjusted EBIT margin between -3.0% and 4.5%, assuming significantly lower Solar revenue; LPKF expects exceptionally high restructuring costs of approximately 3-4% of revenue in 2026 under the North Star transformation program, whose first wave of workforce reduction was completed in Q2.
quarterly_data.figure: 2026 revenue EUR 105 to 120 million; adjusted EBIT margin -3.0% to 4.5%

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 LIDE orders (company release): a leading specialty glass manufacturer (not named) ordered a LIDE system to qualify for future advanced-packaging supply chains, and Penn State University ordered a LIDE system to demonstrate the use of glass substrates for industrial applications in the semiconductor sector. LPKF says it is expanding beyond glass structuring into singulation of glass-based packages and laser-based bonding of multilayer glass stacks.
